acceptance_rule: Research ceiling observed_only regardless of sign. Include the null 100% core vector. Select the deterministic capital-neutral vector that maximizes the sum of classic-window expected_value_score on the exact global 1% grid, then the fixed 0.25% local neighborhood, subject to: aggregate EV delta > 0; aggregate PnL delta > 0; at most one material classic-window regression where EV delta is worse than 1% of that window's core EV and PnL delta is negative; maximum drawdown worsening <= 0.5 percentage points; ES95 worsening <= 5%; total satellite <= 10%; each source-mechanism bucket <= 5%; chronological old_thin->mid_weak and old_thin+mid_weak->late_strong walk-forward folds must each have nonnegative OOS EV and PnL delta. Recent settled forward replacement value is excluded from weight selection and formal Gate arithmetic, but a mapped negative recent contribution rejects interpretation. Missing reconstruction, hash, cash, calendar, concentration, or execution inputs fail closed. No retune after outcome access.

prediction.confidence_reason: The joint gate shape can realize covariance benefits unavailable to the prior one-sleeve tests, but 100% cash-feasible core is a strong comparator and reused adaptive windows plus immature recent sleeves make a stable positive result a low-probability outcome.

calibration.surprise_note: The cash-feasible core dominated every nonzero joint allocation on the declared classic objective. The least harmful global nonzero vector was 1% allocator_policy and 99% core, but it still reduced aggregate EV by 0.030593885024 and PnL by $661.45. At the finer grid, even 0.25% allocator_policy reduced EV by 0.007618242600 and PnL by $165.52. The old_thin-trained 5% allocator_policy plus 5% macro_derivatives vector then lost 0.112700825513 EV and $3,861.49 in mid_weak OOS. Recent forward rows showed only regulatory_event positive, but its 5% hindsight allocation implied just $59.27 versus cash and was excluded from selection.
